githubAbout:
Lead Backend & AI Engineer building production systems, from high-concurrency fintech APIs to applied LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and agent workflows.

At Keyrium Consulting, I lead backend development for Loyalty Rewards and Stock Trading platforms using Node.js, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS, including architecture, third-party integrations, Docker deployment, CI/CD, and 85% test coverage. I also build RAG-assisted tooling for internal documentation search.

Previously, I've improved API and database performance by 30–80% across production backends and shipped multi-provider auth systems (JWT, OAuth 2.0, MFA, RBAC) to production.

Open to lead/senior **backend engineering** and **applied AI engineering** roles (hybrid or remote).

Portfolio: [epic-node.onrender.com](https://epic-node.onrender.com) · [okeowoemmanuelm@gmail.com](mailto:okeowoemmanuelm@gmail.com)
